title: Federal warranty law - Magnuson-Moss basics
facts: The Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act governs written warranties on many consumer products and sets federal disclosure and enforcement rules.

Federal law generally does not require a seller or manufacturer to provide a written warranty, but if a written consumer-product warranty is offered it must comply with applicable federal requirements.
Written warranties are generally designated as full or limited warranties under federal rules.
State warranty and contract law can provide additional rights beyond the federal statute.
